operations.text:
## Explicit coverage of the supplied particulars
The mandatory field list is a minimum, not a reason to leave out a supplied characteristic. State every supplied demographic, financial, household, political and interest requirement explicitly in the JSON, in an appropriate existing field or an additional clearly named field. In particular, include race_ethnicity when it was supplied; nationality and a person's name do not establish it. State the actual residence, gross household income or qualifying income range, partnership status, children status, political identification and requested leisure interest rather than leaving the reader to infer them from an occupation, lifestyle or name.

Before returning the specification, compare these explicit statements with the original particulars. Check that no required characteristic is missing and that the same fact is not contradicted elsewhere. Preserve all original constraints; do not make an unspecified characteristic compulsory.
